description: This file implements bloom filter functionality for a Git-like system, including loading filters, computing hashes, managing bloom filter lifecycle, and checking membership. It contains specific logic for bloom filter creation, upgrade, and usage within a version-controlled repository context.

methods.name: uint32_t rotate_left(uint32_t value,int32_t count)
methods.description: Performs a bitwise rotate left operation on a 32-bit integer.

methods.name: unsigned char get_bitmask(uint32_t pos)
methods.description: Returns a bitmask with a single bit set corresponding to a position within a word.

methods.name: int check_bloom_offset(struct commit_graph * g,uint32_t pos,uint32_t offset)
methods.description: Checks if a given offset is within the bounds of the bloom data in a commit graph chunk.

methods.name: int load_bloom_filter_from_graph(struct commit_graph * g,struct bloom_filter * filter,uint32_t graph_pos)
methods.description: Loads a bloom filter from a commit graph based on a graph position.

methods.name: uint32_t murmur3_seeded_v2(uint32_t seed,const char * data,size_t len)
methods.description: Computes a 32-bit Murmur3 hash with seed, for version 2 hash.

methods.name: uint32_t murmur3_seeded_v1(uint32_t seed,const char * data,size_t len)
methods.description: Computes a 32-bit Murmur3 hash with seed, for version 1 hash.

methods.name: void bloom_key_fill(struct bloom_key * key,const char * data,size_t len,const struct bloom_filter_settings * settings)
methods.description: Fills a bloom key with hash values based on the input data and settings.

methods.name: void bloom_key_clear(struct bloom_key * key)
methods.description: Clears the memory associated with a bloom key.

methods.name: void add_key_to_filter(const struct bloom_key * key,struct bloom_filter * filter,const struct bloom_filter_settings * settings)
methods.description: Adds a key to the bloom filter by setting bits corresponding to its hash values.

methods.name: void init_bloom_filters(void)
methods.description: Initializes the global bloom filter slab.

methods.name: void free_one_bloom_filter(struct bloom_filter * filter)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a single bloom filter.

methods.name: void deinit_bloom_filters(void)
methods.description: Deinitializes and frees all bloom filters.

methods.name: struct:bloom_keyvec * bloom_keyvec_new(const char * path,size_t len,const struct bloom_filter_settings * settings)
methods.description: Creates a new bloom key vector for a path, breaking it into components.

methods.name: void bloom_keyvec_free(struct bloom_keyvec * vec)
methods.description: Frees memory associated with a bloom key vector.

methods.name: void init_truncated_large_filter(struct bloom_filter * filter,int version)
methods.description: Initializes a bloom filter to a truncated large size.

methods.name: int has_entries_with_high_bit(struct repository * r,struct tree * t)
methods.description: Determines if a tree has entries with high-bit set, indicating special paths.

methods.name: int commit_tree_has_high_bit_paths(struct repository * r,struct commit * c)
methods.description: Checks if a commit's tree contains paths with high bits set.

methods.name: struct:bloom_filter * upgrade_filter(struct repository * r,struct commit * c,struct bloom_filter * filter,int hash_version)
methods.description: Upgrades a bloom filter's version if conditions are met.

methods.name: struct:bloom_filter * get_bloom_filter(struct repository * r,struct commit * c)
methods.description: Retrieves the bloom filter for a given commit, if available.

methods.name: struct:bloom_filter * get_or_compute_bloom_filter(struct repository * r,struct commit * c,int compute_if_not_present,const struct bloom_filter_settings * settings,enum bloom_filter_computed * computed)
methods.description: Gets or computes a bloom filter for a given commit, possibly performing diff analysis.

methods.name: int bloom_filter_contains(const struct bloom_filter * filter,const struct bloom_key * key,const struct bloom_filter_settings * settings)
methods.description: Checks if a bloom filter contains a specific key.

methods.name: int bloom_filter_contains_vec(const struct bloom_filter * filter,const struct bloom_keyvec * vec,const struct bloom_filter_settings * settings)
methods.description: Checks if a bloom filter contains all keys in a vector.

methods.name: uint32_t test_bloom_murmur3_seeded(uint32_t seed,const char * data,size_t len,int version)
methods.description: Tests which Murmur3 hash variant to use based on version.

methods.name: int pathmap_cmp(const void * hashmap_cmp_fn_data UNUSED,const struct hashmap_entry * eptr,const struct hashmap_entry * entry_or_key,const void * keydata UNUSED)
methods.description: unavailable
